name: Goodman Artarmon Data Centre (SYD01)

address.value: 2-8 Lanceley Place and 14 Campbell Street, Artarmon NSW
address.note: former ABC studios site; 14,024 sqm across five allotments

postcode.note: suburb postcode (Australia Post); not stated in source

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 2 Lanceley Place (site also includes 4-8 Lanceley Pl and 14 Campbell St)

builder.note: head contractor; contract award announced by A W Edwards Mar 2026 (source 7); first Goodman-AWE collaboration

developer.note: applicant; Goodman to fit out and operate

mw_it.note: 61MW IT across five 12.2MW data halls (Goodman, Mar 2026). The SSD Assessment Report Table 1 lists 'IT Power consumption 80 MW' for the original consent - that figure is the feeder/total capacity (80MVA) and the modified consent (MOD 2) increased feeder capacity to 90MVA

mw_grid.note: MOD 2 (approved 14 Apr 2026) increased feeder capacity from 80MVA to 90MVA; Goodman states 90MW secured utility power. Original consent: 80MVA / 80MW

authority.value: NSW Independent Planning Commission (determined by DPHI under delegation)
authority.note: Assessment Report: IPC was the declared consent authority because Willoughby Council objected during exhibition; Council withdrew its objection in writing on 11 Nov 2024, so under the IPC Chair's 14 June 2022 delegation the application was determined by the Acting Director, Industry Assessments (DPHI) 'as delegate of the Independent Planning Commission'

lodged.note: approximate: EIS uploaded to the major projects portal 6 Jun 2024 and exhibited 3-30 Jul 2024. Earlier value 2024-01-23 was the date of a pre-lodgement ('Development details') document, not lodgement

determined.note: Determination Date 11/04/2025 on planning portal. Modifications: MOD 1 (FSR reduction, alterations, flood works, parking, solar) approved 11 Dec 2025; MOD 2 (capacity to 90MVA, facade, plant, 42 x 2.82MW generators) approved 14 Apr 2026

jobs_construction.note: EIS: 'the development is estimated to generate 669 full-time equivalent jobs consistently throughout the lifetime of development build' ('based on the direct employment impact'), over a ~24-month build; Assessment Report: 'up to 669 full-time equivalent construction jobs'. Tagged average because the source describes a constant FTE level, not a peak

jobs_operational.note: Assessment Report: '30 operational jobs' / '30 knowledge-intensive operational jobs'; Goodman release also 30

jobs_operational_other.note: EIS p.40: engineering operations 26 staff (11 per shift x 2 + 4 managers) + data centre operations 20 staff = 'total number of operational jobs for the proposal is 46 jobs' (the same EIS elsewhere says 30 full time workers)

construction_start.note: official commencement of construction marked 3 Mar 2026 (Goodman / A W Edwards)

construction_end.note: expected: first 12.2MW phase ready for service Q2 2028 (A W Edwards: early 2028); delivered in five stages, final completion date not stated

open_questions: construction_end is first phase only; full build-out date unknown
a MOD 3 application (SSD-66777221-MOD-3, Aug 2026) appears on the portal - not reviewed
